K.Sundaralingam vs The Commissioner on 1 April, 2024 
Author: G.R.Swaminathan Bench: G.R.Swaminathan  W.P(MD)No.62  BEFORE THE MADURAI BENCH OF MADRAS HIGH COURT  DATED : 01.04.2024  CORAM  THE HONOURABLE MR.JUSTICE G.R.SWAMINATHAN  W.P(MD)No.627 of 2024  and  W.M.P.(MD)Nos.639, 640 and 641 of 2024  K.Sundaralingam ... Petitioner  Vs.

1  W.P(
 Prayer : Writ Petition filed under Article 226 of the Constitution of In  praying this Court to issue a Writ of Certiorarified Mandamus, calling f  entire records relating to the impugned proce  Na.Ka.No.2870/A2/2023/U.Pa.a, dated 27.12.2023 issued  2nd respondent and quash the same as illegal and consequently permit the  petitioner to run the Petty Shop namesly M/s.K.S.Cool Drinks situated at  Thataneri Main Road, Bharathinagar, Madurai by unsealing the premises.
 For Petitioner : Ms.S.Meena,
 For Mr.A.L.Kannan. 
 For Respondents : Mr.Veerakathiravan,
 Addl. Advocate General,
 Assisted by Mr.D.Sasi Kumar,
 Addl. Government Pleader for R1 to R3.
 Mr.A.Albert James,
 Govt. Advocate (Crl. Side) for R4. 
 ORDER Heard the learned counsel for the writ petitioner, the learned Additional Advocate General assisted by the learned Additional Government Pleader for the respondents 1 to 3 and the learned Government Advocate (Crl. Side) for the fourth respondent.
2.The petitioner is running a petty shop. It was locked and sealed on 27.12.2023 by the second respondent. The learned Additional Advocate https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis General points out that the petitioner is having a bad track record. The petitioner undertakes to compound the offence. 
The petitioner has to pay the compounding charges to the tune of Rs.5,000/-. The second respondent shall issue proceedings immediately and the petitioner shall also remit the same. I am inclined to show indulgence only for the reason that full three months have elapsed. I hope the petitioner has learnt his lesson. Subject to the petitioner compounding the offence, the lock and seal shall be removed. The entire exercise shall be completed within a period of seven days from the date of receipt of a copy of this order. 
3.This writ petition is allowed on these terms. No costs. Consequently, connected miscellaneous petitions are closed.
